metadata.case_name: CHENG SAI KAM v. TUTTI LTD (IN LIQUIDATION)

plaintiff.occupation_before: Casual decoration worker (specialised in painting); previously worked as barber
plaintiff.occupation_after: Unemployed (since about Jan 2017) and dependent on public assistance

injuries.description: laceration on dorsum of left foot with cut extensor tendon of his left 4th toe
source: The diagnosis at A&E department of the hospital was laceration left foot with cut tendon.
There was a laceration over the dorsum of his left foot. There was a tendon cut.
The wound was explored on admission under local anesthesia.The extensor digitorum communis tendon to the left 4th toe was found to be completely cut and repaired.
As a result of the Accident, the plaintiff, opined Dr Wong, suffered from laceration on dorsum of his left foot with cut extensor tendon of his left 4th toe.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration of muscle, fascia or tendon of long extensor muscle of toe at ankle or foot level

manifestations.description: Residual stiffness in his left 4th toe
Persistent pain in his left foot after prolonged walking
Limited ability to stand on rung-ladder and inability to climb ladder due to pain
3.5cm oblique scar over dorsum of metatarsophalangeal joint of left 4th toe; tenderness over the scar; slight stiffness at the joint; active extension of 4th toe with power grade 4/5

treatments_received.treatment: Exploration of wound and repair of extensor digitorum communis tendon to the left 4th toe under local anesthesia
source: The wound was explored on admission under local anesthesia.The extensor digitorum communis tendon to the left 4th toe was found to be completely cut and repaired.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Tendon repair / Suture of tendon not involving hand

treatments_received.treatment: Re-repair of extensor tendon under local anesthesia (14 Sept 2012)
source: On 14 Sept 2012, the tendon was found to have re-ruptured. It was repaired under local anesthesia on the same day.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Secondary repair of tendon, including graft, transfer and / or prosthesis

treatments_received.treatment: Short leg cast and heel walking
source: Short leg cast was applied. The plaintiff was put on heel walking and prescribed with antibiotics.
Short leg cast was applied. The plaintiff was put on heel walking and prescribed with antibiotics.

treatments_received.treatment: Physiotherapy (9 sessions from 17 Jan 2013 to 12 Apr 2013)
source: He had a total of 9 sessions of physiotherapy treatment at the hospital from 17 Jan 2013 to 12 Apr 2013.

treatments_received.treatment: Referral to occupational therapist for work assessment
source: On outpatient orthopedic follow-up, the plaintiffs wound has healed. He was referred to physiotherapist for mobilization exercise and occupational therapist for work assessment.

treatments_received.treatment: Hepatocellular carcinoma surgery (partial hepatectomy) - admitted to PWH for 10 days (2014)
source: In 2014, the plaintiff was diagnosed to have liver cancer. He was admitted to Prince of Wales Hospital (PWH) for 10 days and received hepatocellular carcinoma surgery (partial hepatectomy).
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Segmentectomy of liver, open or laparoscopic

treatments_received.treatment: Partial hepatectomy - admitted to PWH for 7 days (Feb 2018)
source: In Feb 2018, the plaintiff was again admitted to PWH for 7 days to receive another partial hepatectomy.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Segmentectomy of liver, open or laparoscopic

losses.description: Residual stiffness in left 4th toe, persistent left foot pain after prolonged walking, limited ability to stand on rung-ladder and inability to climb ladder due to pain
